ctx.x: Ella. Oh, well, anyway, in Ella's case, she took a few bars of another recording that I had made, 'Lady Be Good.' And she took a few bars and which was more a compliment to me. She took a few bars of one of my solos in 'Lady Be Good' and riffed it the same way that I played it, you know, and that was more or less a compliment, you know.
So she didn't take a whole chorus. She just took a --
